newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS SOFTER UNDER IMPORT PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS SOFTER UNDER IMPORT PRESSURE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar finished Monday's interbank trading session easier against major currencies on the back of import pressure, dealers said.

"I should think the market sentiment was that we were a bit on the short side but the impact was not very big. The local dollar didn't move much from its morning levels," a dealer commented, adding that the central Reserve Bank had not intervened to help the currency.
The Zimbabwe dollar closed weaker at 10.7550/7750 against the U.S. dollar compared to 10.7350/7550 last Friday and was at 17.8500/8700 versus pound sterling, down from 17.8000/8500.
Against the rand, it eased to 2.2800/3000 from 2.2650/2750 but edged up on the mark to 6.9200/9400 from 6.9600/9800.
